page.layout: One page of text, one column of verb-conjugation lines with interlinear German glosses; no margin notes. Page number 137 at top right; catchword "Che noi" at foot right; signature/page number 15 at foot left.

main_text.p: Noi tenerèmo, & terrèmo, nos tenebimus, wir werden halten.
Voi tenerete, & terrète, vos tenebitis, jhr werdet halten.
Coloro teneranno, terranno, illi tenebunt, sie werden halten.
main_text.head: Imperatiuo modo temp. praf.
main_text.p: Tieni tu, tene tu, halt du,
Tenga colui, teneat ille, halt er.
Teniamo noi, teneamus nos, halten wir.
Tenete voi, tenete vos, halter jhr.
Tengano coloro, teneant illi, halten sie.
main_text.head: Futurum Imperat.
main_text.p: Tenerai vel terrai tu, teneto tu, du solt oder solst halten.
Tenera vel terra colui, teneto ille, er soll halten.
Teneremo vel terremo noi, teneamus nos, wir sollen halten.
Tenerete vel terrete voi, tenetote vos, jhr sollet halten.
Teneranno coloro vel terranno, tenento illi, sie sollen halten.
main_text.head: Optatiuo modo temp. fut. & praesent.
Conjunct.
main_text.p: O Dio voglia &c. ch'io tenga, Vtinam ego teneam, Wolte Gott, daß ich halte.
Tu tenga, colui tenga, tu teneas, ille teneat, daß du halteft, daß er halte.

page.notes: Some glosses and the Latin forms are faint; the word "solst" in the future imperative line is read from a broken "solt/solt" with [?] not needed but the German "sollen" forms are partly worn.
